A bronze ship's bell cast for the colony ship Ardent Mercy, hung at Lantern's inner dock lock on the Bell Hook. Rung once for every death on Lantern, and the dead's name cut into it: around the lip, then the waist, then wherever there is room.

The Halden-Ash ledger engine in the Counting House vault. Every lock, pump, scrubber and still on Lantern is keyed to it. It debits each indentured person for air, water and heat and credits their labour. A balance past the line is dimmed: doors close, rations stop.
A brass key-disk on a chain, the Director's half of the Tally's root keys. Engraved H-A.
Teodor Basu's half of the Tally's root keys: a slip of ceramic with a cipher burned into it, worn in his shoe.
Fusion fuel cassettes for the Wick, each the size of a coffin. Company property.
A stamped metal token printed with a person's Tally number and balance, carried on a cord. Children get theirs at six.
Teodor's reconstruction, from payroll, of the names of the dead of Caul Deep. Paper.
The key by which the Comptroller-General of the Count administers the Tally. Kept in the Hulk; never shown.
